# Close

<p class="gls-text-lead">Create a close icon that can be combined with different components.</p>

## Usage

To apply this component, add the `gls-close` attribute to an `<a>` or `<button>` element.

```html
<button type="button" gls-close></button>

<a href="" gls-close></a>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<button type="button" aria-label="Close" gls-close></button>
</div>

```html
<button type="button" aria-label="Close" gls-close></button>
```

***

## Large modifier

Add the `.gls-close-large` class for a larger close button.


```html
<button class="gls-close-large" type="button" gls-close></button>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<button class="gls-close-large" type="button" aria-label="Close" gls-close></button>
</div>

```html
<button class="gls-close-large" type="button" aria-label="Close" gls-close></button>
```

***

## Close in alerts

This is an example of how this component is used with an alert box from the [Alert component](https://getuikit.com/docs/alert).

```html
<div gls-alert>
    <button class="gls-alert-close" type="button" gls-close></button>
</div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">

</div>

## Close in drops

This is an example of how this component is used with the [Drop component](https://getuikit.com/docs/drop).

```html
<div gls-drop>
    <button class="gls-drop-close" type="button" gls-close></button>
</div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-inline">
    <button class="gls-button gls-button-default" type="button">Click</button>
    <div gls-drop="mode: click">
        <div class="gls-card gls-card-body gls-card-default">
            <button class="gls-drop-close" type="button" aria-label="Close" gls-close></button>
            <p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt.</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</div>

## Close in modals

This is an example of how this component is used with the [Modal component](https://getuikit.com/docs/modal).

```html
<div id="modal" gls-modal>
    <div class="gls-modal-dialog gls-modal-body">
        <button class="gls-modal-close-default" type="button" gls-close></button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

The Close component automatically sets the appropriate WAI-ARIA roles and properties.

- The *close icon* has the `aria-label` property, and if an `<a>` element is used, the `button` role.

### Internationalization

The Close component uses the following translation strings. Learn more about [translating components](https://getuikit.com/docs/accessibility#internationalization).

| Key          | Default        | Description             |
|--------------|----------------|-------------------------|
| `label`      | `Close`        | `aria-label` attribute. |
